06:00 PM
p.m.

505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.

2.

4A.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.

REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.

CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 9/16/15 Regular Meeting, 9/23/15 Special Meeting, and 9/23/15 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2015-10-14 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2015-10-14 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
Resolution 2015-64 amending the Fiscal Year 2015-16 Budget authorizing an appropriation of $307,000 from the Facilities Capital Maintenance Fund. Contact Person: Management Analyst Wilson
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015-64, amending the Fiscal Year 2015-16 Budget, and authorizing an appropriation of $307,000 from the Facilities Capital Maintenance Fund.
2015-10-14 Item 8C - Facilities Capital Maint. Fund
8D.
Construction contract for the Pavement Rehabilitation and Overlay Project FY2015-2016 (CS16A). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Hefner
1) Authorize the Director of Public Works, or his designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a contract with Daley Corporation in the amount of $2,703,114 plus 10% contingencies plus any additional additive alternatives to construct the Pavement Rehabilitation and Overlay Project FY2015-2016, for a total contract amount not to exceed $2,973,426; and, 2) Authorize the Director of Public Works, or his designee, to amend Daley Corporation's contract to extend completion dates if necessary.
2015-10-14 Item 8D - Pavement Rehab Construction Award
8E.
Amendment to the Agreement with Tyler Technologies, Inc. for the purchase and implementation of EnerGov software for Planning, Building and Public Works engineering permits, inspections, code enforcement and citizen self service. Contact Person: IT/GIS Project Manager Van Pelt
1) Authorize the City Manager to enter into an amended agreement with Tyler Technologies, Inc. for professional services and upgrade to a software site license in an amount not to exceed $323,338 and Annual Software Maintenance (ASM) fees in the amount of $76,804; and, 2) Approve a 15% contingency amount of $48,501.
2015-10-14 Item 8E - EnerGov Agreement Amendment
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing to consider the introduction of Draft City Council Ordinance No. 2015-05, which proposes changes to the City's density bonus ordinance to implement California density bonus law. The proposed ordinance will amend the City's Zoning Ordinance and Local Coastal Program. Project #14-202 POD. Contact Person: Special Counsel Kautz
1) Receive the staff report; 2) Open public hearing and receive and consider public testimony; and, 3) Introduce draft Ordinance No. 2015-05 titled, "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, amending Chapter 30.16.020.C [Density Bonuses Pursuant to Government Code Section 65915] of the Encinitas Municipal Code" as reflected in Attachment A for the reasons specified in the Agenda Report.
2015-10-14 Item 10A - Density Bonus Ordinance Public Hearing
10B.
City Council reconsideration of actions taken on July 16, 2014 relating to the application and/or interpretation of the City's policies related to state density bonus law. Contact Person: Special Counsel Kautz
a. Directed staff to follow Municipal Code Section 30.16.010(B) (1), which provides for rounding down when the base density results in a fractional unit. b. Required that any affordable dwelling units included in a density bonus project must be at least 75% of the size of the market rate units, and at a minimum must meet the standard set forth in the Inclusionary Housing ordinance. c. Waiver requests based on physical infeasibility must be accompanied by sufficient documentation to demonstrate the claim of infeasibility. If the City determines that a smaller unit size could be accommodated without the waivers, such waivers should be denied. If the developer requests an incentive based on financial infeasibility, the City must require financial documentation to justify the request. d. Directed staff to implement these policies effective immediately and shall be applied to any projects not yet permitted or holding vested rights; and, 4) Direct staff to ensure that density bonus applications fully comply with the provisions of Government Code Section 65915.
2015-10-14 Item 10B - Reconsideration of Council Density Bonus Policies
10C.
Public Hearing of the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Encinitas - Solana Beach Coastal Storm Damage Reduction Project and certify the Final Environmental Impact Study/Final Environmental Impact Report. Contact Person: Program Administrator Weldon
1) Adopt Resolution 2015-39 approving a budget adjustment in the amount of $25,000 for Fiscal Year 2015/16; 2) Adopt Resolution 2015-36 to Certify the Final Environmental Impact Study/Environmental Impact Report; Adopt the Mitigation, Monitoring and Reporting Program and Findings of Fact; Approve the Proposed Project (Alt EN-1B) for Encinitas; and 3) Authorize acceptance of $225,000 in grant funding from the State Parks and Recreation Department to support the Preconstruction Engineering and Design phase of the project for Fiscal Year 2015-2016.
2015-10-14 Item 10C - USACE Public Hearing
10D.
Traffic and Public Safety Commission prioritization of Let's Move, Encinitas! Pedestrian and Safe Routes to School Plan Projects. Contact Person: Deputy Director Deane
Receive staff report and accept Traffic and Public Safety Commission prioritized list of projects.
2015-10-14 Item 10D - Let's Move Encinitas Projects

Receive staff's informational report and provide any direction necessary.
2015-10-14 Item 11A - El Nino Storm Preparations - Information Item

ADJOURNMENT CERTIFICATION
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
